title: 1997 AMC 8 Problem 6
statement: In the number \(74982.1035\) the value of the place occupied by the digit \(9\) is how many times as great as the value of the place occupied by the digit \(3?\)

solutions.text:
Note that each digit has ten times the value of the digit to its right.

The place occupied by \(9\) is \(5\) spaces to the left of the place occupied by \(3.\)

This means that it is \[ 10^5 = 100,000 \] times as great.

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Each step left in place value multiplies by \(10\)
Compare the place values occupied by \(9\) and \(3\)
